definition.name: Recheck same-run native evidence and build the standard backend

steps.name: Fetch only the original pinned control histories
steps.run:
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin b606b1402961593dd918722a66fe293bfab9b319
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin c7134289f446cb3171eb0ffd800a94afc2a5209f
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"

steps.name: Restore this run's five bounded native products
Install the verified wasm-tools release asset
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-wasm-tools.tar.gz"
bindir="$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-wasm-tools-bin"
mkdir "$bindir"
timeout 90s gh api -H 'Accept: application/octet-stream' repos/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/releases/assets/483720667 | head -c 5862465 > "$archive"
unset GH_TOKEN
test "$(stat --format=%s "$archive")" = 5862464
printf '%s  %s\n' d0efb16c9c859137b7ab3e99151c299cd47caee106ed4594561002f7a04945bd "$archive" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xOzf "$archive" wasm-tools-1.254.0-x86_64-linux/wasm-tools > "$bindir/wasm-tools"
test "$(stat --format=%s "$bindir/wasm-tools")" = 20231696
printf '%s  %s\n' cc1f862d69363aac2d4a88f01c414a2dcf10858632d0c0a45e93ff60503979d6 "$bindir/wasm-tools" | sha256sum --check --strict
chmod 755 "$bindir/wasm-tools"
test "$("$bindir/wasm-tools" --version)" = 'wasm-tools 1.254.0 (bb58fdf91 2026-07-20)'
printf '%s\n' "$bindir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Acquire locked compiler dependencies
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
cargo fetch --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

steps.name: Verify same-run source and compile the ordinary backend
Retain bounded backend result and build evidence

reviewReason: Preserve exact native bounds and same-run evidence before the ordinary backend build.
